description: Add a new version to an existing document by uploading a file over a multipart request, replacing that document's current file. The bytes are scanned and a rejected file fails the call; a read-only entity, an open desktop editing session, and a current version that changed under you are all conflicts. An agent surface cannot send multipart: use uploads.create with purpose entity_version and then uploads.update.

alternative.note: presign with purpose entity_version, PUT the bytes to the returned URL, then finalize
